description:
Local git in one call: `action` = status | diff | log | branch | commit | stash | push. status: parsed worktree state (branch, ahead/behind, per-file staged/unstaged/untracked, counts, clean). diff: staged (`staged=true`) or worktree diff: per-file action (added|modified|deleted|renamed) + hunks; unified text opt-in via `include_patch=true` (byte-capped by max_bytes). log: commit list or `--blame` for one file (`path` + `blame=true`); filters ref/author/grep. branch: `sub` = list|current|create|switch|delete (name/from/include_remote/force). commit: message (required, first line = subject, max 1000 chars); stages paths[] first, else commits already-staged; `allow_empty`/`amend` opt-in. stash: `sub` = push|list|apply|pop|drop|show (selector stash@{N}, message max 1000 chars, include_untracked=1 for -u). push: one local branch (`ref`, default current) to a configured remote NAME (`remote`, not a URL; default its remote/origin); `set_upstream`, `tags`, `dry_run`; no force/delete (shell_run, approval); credentials non-interactive; refused under strict profile. Audited reason needed for mutations.
Use when: you need the repo state, a diff, history/blame, a branch/stash, a commit or a push. blame for who last touched lines; log with author/grep for filtered history; diff (not shell_run git) for hunk previews.
Avoid when: you need a force-push, delete-push or a push to a URL (shell_run, approval), or a remote host's CI status (ci_status).
Output: status: ok, branch/detached, upstream (gone flag), ahead/behind, files[] {path, old_path?, staged, unstaged, untracked, unmerged, kind, status, index_status/worktree_status}, counts{}, clean. diff: files[] {old_path|null, new_path|null, action, hunks[] {old_start, old_lines, new_start, new_lines, section}}, counts{}, patch_bytes, patch/patch_truncated when include_patch=true. log: commits[] {sha, short_sha, author, email, authored_at, committer, subject, body} (blame mode: entries[] {line, commit, author, authored_at, summary}). branch: list -> current, branches[]; create/switch/delete -> created/switched/deleted/force (missing branch -> not_found; duplicate -> conflict). commit: sha, short_sha, subject, files_changed, files, amend (no staged changes -> invalid_request; pass allow_empty=true). stash: pushed, message, selector, output / entries[] {selector, sha, subject}, count. push: remote, branch, pushed, up_to_date, dry_run, updates[] {flag, ref, status new|pushed|forced|up_to_date|rejected, summary}; rejected -> conflict, no credentials -> invalid_request, slow remote -> timeout (120s).

action.description: Which git operation to run: status | diff | log | branch | commit | stash | push.

allow_empty.description: action=commit: true allows an empty commit (git commit --allow-empty).

amend.description: action=commit: true amends HEAD instead of creating a new commit.

author.description: action=log: filter commits by author name or email.

blame.description: action=log: true switches to blame mode for path (optionally ref).

dry_run.description: action=push: true only reports what would be pushed.

force.description: action=branch sub=delete: true allows deleting an unmerged branch (git branch -D); false uses -d.

grep.description: action=log: filter commit messages by substring.

include_patch.description: action=diff: true includes the unified diff text (truncated to max_bytes).

include_remote.description: action=branch sub=list: true includes remote-tracking branches in the list.

include_untracked.description: action=stash sub=push: true includes untracked files when pushing.

message.description: action=commit: commit message (first line is the subject, required). action=stash sub=push: optional note stored in the stash entry.

path.description: action=log + blame: the file to blame.

paths.description: Optional workspace-relative paths. status/diff/log/stash: limits what the command looks at. commit: paths to stage first (git add); omit to commit the already-staged set. Not used by action=branch.

ref.description: Optional ref (branch, tag or commit sha). Default: HEAD. action=push: local branch to push (default: checked-out branch).

remote.description: action=push: configured remote NAME (not a URL). Default: the branch's remote, else origin.

selector.description: action=stash sub=apply|pop|drop: stash selector (default stash@{0}); format stash@{N}.

set_upstream.description: action=push: true sets the upstream (git push -u).

staged.description: action=diff: true compares the index to HEAD (git diff --cached); false compares worktree to HEAD/index.

anyOf.description: Branch sub-action (action=branch): list (default; local branches, include_remote=true for origin), current (checked-out branch), create/switch/delete (name required; create uses from=start ref, default HEAD; delete uses force=true to keep an unmerged branch).
Stash sub-action (action=stash): push (staged+unstaged tracked changes; include_untracked=true adds -u), list (default), show, apply/pop/drop (selector stash@{N}).

sub.description: Branch sub-action when action=branch (list|current|create|switch|delete); stash sub-action when action=stash (push|list|apply|pop|drop|show). Default: list.
